newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: TAIWAN BUYS SEP 0.5-PCT FUEL OIL AT $124, $128/T.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN BUYS SEP 0.5-PCT FUEL OIL AT $124, $128/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender at least one 38,000-tonne cargo each of low and high pour 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil at $128 and $124 per tonne, respectively, a CPC official said on Thursday.
"We have bought at least one cargo of low pour and one cargo of high pour fuel oil," he said.
Industry sources said CPC might have bought two low pour cargoes, but the official declined to confirm.
The cargoes are for delivery in the second half of September on a cost-and-freight basis to Keelung, Taichung or Shenao, the official said.
In its last tender, Taiwan bought two cargoes at $129 and $120 per tonne for September delivery.
The first low pour cargo was awarded at $129 for September 1-10 delivery and the high pour cargo at $120 for September 21-30 delivery.
